jobs.title: Sales Development Rep (AI Startup)
jobs.description: Tenor is the AI coaching platform that the world's biggest companies use to make their leaders better — through realistic, voice-driven simulations. We're early-stage, VC-backed, and growing fast. Our customers include names you'd recognize instantly, and our product sells itself once people see it. We're hiring an SDR to join a growth team that's already winning. You'll have outbound playbooks that convert, the best GTM AI tools in the game, and a team that will make you sharper every week. This is primarily a phone role — you'll be dialing into F500s and having real conversations with senior leaders. LinkedIn is your second channel. If you want to be at an AI startup that works with the world's best companies, learn from a founding team that's done this before, and have a growth experinece you'll look back on — keep reading! You: - You've got about a year of SDR experience under your belt — ideally in enterprise SaaS — and you're hungry for more - You can get a senior L&D leader at a Fortune 500 on the phone and hold a conversation that feels warm, insightful, and authentic - You write the way you talk: clearly, with personality - LinkedIn isn't just a tool for you — it's a weapon - You're fired up about AI, curious about the future of leadership, and you want to sell something you actually believe in - You thrive with autonomy but you're at your best inside a tight, high-trust team that pushes each other - You know your way around Sales Nav, HubSpot, and modern outbound tools — and if you don't, you'll figure it out fast The Role: - Your north star will be the number of meetings attended by qualified personas at Tenor’s ICP - and your variable comp is structured to reward your successes here - You’ll run outbound prospecting across multiple channels, with phone being your primary - You’ll help create and refine messaging, sequences, and targeting - and double down on what works - You’ll bring insight from your conversations back to the team to help us iterate on positioning, product, and strategy Benefits: - Competitive base salary and variable comp structure - An equity stake - you’ll have ownership in what we’re building - Full medical, dental, and vision coverage - 401(k) - Generous PTO policy - Annual learning and development stipend - Home office setup budget - Regular offsites and retreats — we like being in person whenever we can! - Conference travel - A chance to do the best work of your career, on something that really matters

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: At Tenor, we’re on a mission to transform workforce development - making every employee more effective, at the world's largest companies, through the power of AI. People are what determine organizational performance, employee experience, and retention. Yet most companies still develop their workforce through slide decks and annual trainings that never touch the moments that actually matter. That’s why we built Tenor, the AI for workforce development. Our platform lets employees practice hard conversations - like feedback, performance reviews, sales calls, and customer escalations - with realistic voice AI characters. Then we give them instant feedback to help them improve. We’re backed by great investors and our enterprise customers include major name-brand companies. Working at Tenor We’re a team of good-hearted people building excellent product. We’re a people-first company: we want to be a great place to work for our employees, and a valued partner for our customers. Our team is distributed around the world, with our cofounders based in San Francisco, CA. The Role You can be located anywhere in the world, although you must overlap with US Pacific Time for at least 4 working hours between 9am and 5pm. We're looking for a Senior AI Product Engineer who ships quality code quickly, collaborates well with a team, and cares about the people around them. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you will: - Work closely with the founding team to design and build the world's best management training solution, powered by state-of-the-art AI models. - Own product surfaces end-to-end - conversation flows, feedback interfaces, admin tooling - from idea through implementation to shipped, iterated-on user experience. - Produce high-quality software with minimal bugs, clean code, and lasting architecture. - Optimize our LLM usage to produce the best possible output, and build the supporting infrastructure (RAG pipelines, eval setups) as needed. - Build data integrations and figure out the best way to use our data - Serve as a role model as we build the best culture in the industry: a place where excellence and honesty can coexist with kindness, playfulness, and supportiveness. The ideal candidate will... - Ship quality product code quickly, and have a history of taking projects from conception to execution. - Be strong in TypeScript or JavaScript and comfortable owning features across our primarily-TypeScript stack, from frontend to backend. - Have good product instincts - you think about the end-user experience, not just the underlying system. - Have experience working with LLMs (prompting, fine-tuning, RAG, evals) and are excited to deepen that skillset, even if it's not the majority of your background. - Have informed architectural opinions (but also be flexible when others disagree!) - Love to work with a team and collaborate towards a shared goal - Care about the people around you: other employees, customers, and of course all of the supportive people in your personal life. - Overlap with US Pacific Time for at least 4 working hours between 9am and 5pm. - Bring enthusiasm, energy, and care to add to our team culture What's In It For You - We pay our employees fairly, with strong compensation packages. - We offer great healthcare benefits, 401(k), a learning and development stipend, a home office stipend, generous paid time off, and commuter benefits. - You get to work with great people on a high-performing team that genuinely cares about each other. Tenor is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected class.

raw.title: Senior AI Product Engineer
raw.descriptionHtml:
At Tenor, we’re on a mission to transform workforce development - making every employee more effective, at the world's largest companies, through the power of AI.

People are what determine organizational performance, employee experience, and retention. Yet most companies still develop their workforce through slide decks and annual trainings that never touch the moments that actually matter.

That’s why we built Tenor, the AI for workforce development. Our platform lets employees practice hard conversations - like feedback, performance reviews, sales calls, and customer escalations - with realistic voice AI characters. Then we give them instant feedback to help them improve.

We’re backed by great investors and our enterprise customers include major name-brand companies.

Working at Tenor
We’re a team of good-hearted people building excellent product. We’re a people-first company: we want to be a great place to work for our employees, and a valued partner for our customers. Our team is distributed around the world, with our cofounders based in San Francisco, CA.

The Role

You can be located anywhere in the world, although you must overlap with US Pacific Time for at least 4 working hours between 9am and 5pm.

We're looking for a Senior AI Product Engineer who ships quality code quickly, collaborates well with a team, and cares about the people around them.

As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you will:

  • Work closely with the founding team to design and build the world's best management training solution, powered by state-of-the-art AI models.

  • Own product surfaces end-to-end - conversation flows, feedback interfaces, admin tooling - from idea through implementation to shipped, iterated-on user experience.

  • Produce high-quality software with minimal bugs, clean code, and lasting architecture.

  • Optimize our LLM usage to produce the best possible output, and build the supporting infrastructure (RAG pipelines, eval setups) as needed.

  • Build data integrations and figure out the best way to use our data

  • Serve as a role model as we build the best culture in the industry: a place where excellence and honesty can coexist with kindness, playfulness, and supportiveness.

The ideal candidate will...

  • Ship quality product code quickly, and have a history of taking projects from conception to execution.

  • Be strong in TypeScript or JavaScript and comfortable owning features across our primarily-TypeScript stack, from frontend to backend.

  • Have good product instincts - you think about the end-user experience, not just the underlying system.

  • Have experience working with LLMs (prompting, fine-tuning, RAG, evals) and are excited to deepen that skillset, even if it's not the majority of your background.

  • Have informed architectural opinions (but also be flexible when others disagree!)

  • Love to work with a team and collaborate towards a shared goal

  • Care about the people around you: other employees, customers, and of course all of the supportive people in your personal life.

  • Overlap with US Pacific Time for at least 4 working hours between 9am and 5pm.

  • Bring enthusiasm, energy, and care to add to our team culture

What's In It For You

  • We pay our employees fairly, with strong compensation packages.

  • We offer great healthcare benefits, 401(k), a learning and development stipend, a home office stipend, generous paid time off, and commuter benefits.

  • You get to work with great people on a high-performing team that genuinely cares about each other.

    Tenor is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected class.
